events.name: Bash
events.head: Check share-card commit ancestry and source
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -1; for c in 06f00427 41b1fcac origin/main; do git merge-base --is-ancestor 757b2ecd $c && echo "757b2ecd in $c"; done; git rev-parse --short origin/main; git log --oneline 41b1fcac..origin/main -- app/ | head; grep -c '50M' app/src/app/masterclass/masterclass-client.tsx app/src/app/masterclass/page.tsx; sed -n 1,44p app/src/app/masterclass/page.tsx | grep -nE 'title|description' | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fetch mirror page and check share metadata
events.input: $ cd /tmp; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/masterclass/?v=$(date +%s)" -o mc.html; wc -c < mc.html; grep -oE '<meta (property|name)="(og:title|og:description|twitter:title|description)"[^>]*>' mc.html; echo "webinar: $(grep -oi webinar mc.html|wc -l)  50M: $(grep -c '50M' mc.html) refund: $(grep -oiE 'refund|money-back|risk-free' mc.html|wc -l)"; curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/commits/HEAD | grep -m2 -E '"sha"|"message"'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check app changes since publish and webinar contexts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline 41b1fcac..origin/main -- app/src/app/masterclass app/src/components/masterclass app/src/lib/funnel.ts app/src/lib/prices.json app/src/app/layout.tsx | head; echo ---; grep -oiE '.{60}webinar.{40}' /tmp/mc.html | head -5; echo ---; curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/commits?path=site/masterclass/index.html&per_page=1" | grep -m2 -E '"sha"|"message"'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run both probes against the mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; (BASE=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site PREFIX=/ node scripts/probe-funnels.mjs > /tmp/t001-pf.log 2>&1; echo "pf exit $?" >> /tmp/t001-pf.log) & (BASE=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site PREFIX=/ node scripts/probe-workshop.mjs > /tmp/t001-pw.log 2>&1; echo "pw exit $?" >> /tmp/t001-pw.log) & wait; tail -4 /tmp/t001-pf.log; grep -ciE '390|1440' /tmp/t001-pf.log; grep -cE '^\s*(ok|✓)' /tmp/t001-pw.log; grep -iE 'fail|✗' /tmp/t001-pw.log | head -6; tail -2 /tmp/t001-pw.log
